summary: Lung carcinoma morphology rules covering adenocarcinoma growth patterns, squamous nests, alveolar/bronchial structures, lumina, and true stromal interfaces.

rules.claim: A lepidic-pattern edit must preserve pre-existing alveolar septal geometry and airspaces rather than filling them as a solid tumor mass.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A clearly identified transition to solid or invasive growth requires a separately selected same-pattern interface.
counterexamples: Morphological closing that fills alveolar spaces.
Growing a convex tumor blob across preserved lung parenchyma.
expected_morphology: Tumor remains distributed along alveolar walls with preserved open airspaces where visible.
forbidden_morphology: Airspace filling, septal bridging, bulk solidification, or loss of alveolar topology.
known_limitations: Collapsed semantic masks may not encode alveolar septa and spaces separately.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Do not create an abrupt notch, split, fusion, or lumen closure in a recognizable acinar tumor gland.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: Poorly formed or mixed-pattern interfaces require explicit pattern classification and uncertainty.
counterexamples: A deep narrow regression bite into one acinus.
An expansion joining two acini by filling intervening stroma.
expected_morphology: Continuous gland contour and plausible lumen remain identifiable.
forbidden_morphology: Acute notch, gland split/merge, lumen fill, or detached tumor island.
known_limitations: Tangential acinar sections can mimic papillary or solid patterns.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Preserve fibrovascular cores in papillary growth and the coreless, detached/airspace-associated character of micropapillary tufts; do not convert one into the other through bulk filling.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: Mixed patterns require same-pattern reference selection and may warrant abstention at ambiguous boundaries.
counterexamples: Connecting micropapillary tufts into a solid bridge.
Erasing a papillary fibrovascular core during tumor expansion.
expected_morphology: Papillary cores remain intact; micropapillary tufts remain compatible with coreless airspace growth.
forbidden_morphology: Core deletion, invented cores, broad bridging, or airspace filling.
known_limitations: Micropapillary clusters may be smaller than semantic-mask resolution.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Even when tumor is solid, expansion must remain on an H&E-compatible invasive front and must not consume airspace, bronchial epithelium, cartilage, vessel, or necrosis as generic stroma.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A dedicated invasion or necrosis primitive with explicit target structure.
counterexamples: Expanding a solid component across a bronchial lumen.
Filling labeled necrosis to make a smoother solid mass.
expected_morphology: A cohesive boundary displacement limited to compatible adjacent tissue.
forbidden_morphology: Cross-airspace bridges, bronchial-wall damage, vessel loss, or necrosis filling.
known_limitations: Solid adenocarcinoma and squamous carcinoma may need ancillary context in difficult cases.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: A squamous tumor edit must preserve coherent nests/cords and keratinized centers or intercellular-bridge context where present.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: Discohesive or poorly differentiated SCC requires explicit observation and a compatible reference.
counterexamples: A deep wedge cut into a keratinized nest.
Filling a keratin pearl center with tumor label.
Growing a detached tumor island from remote keratin debris.
expected_morphology: Nest/cord boundary and central keratin relationship remain coherent.
forbidden_morphology: Abrupt nest notch, center filling, keratin-debris seeding, or remote island.
known_limitations: IGNITE coarse Tumor does not encode histologic subtype or keratinization separately after remap.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Do not treat bronchial epithelium, alveolar tissue/airspaces, cartilage, or smooth muscle as interchangeable stromal source tissue.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A coarse profile may support only a generic non-tumor edit and must state the semantic limitation explicitly.
counterexamples: Growing tumor through an alveolar space because it is zero.
Using bronchial lining or cartilage as the source of a stroma edit.
expected_morphology: The selected source band is true compatible tissue and protected structures remain unchanged.
forbidden_morphology: Airspace filling, bronchial-rim transection, cartilage/muscle consumption, or zero-label editing.
known_limitations: The IGNITE unified profile collapses multiple native supporting tissues.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Use a broad interface from the same histologic pattern and anatomical context; spread area along the interface before increasing depth.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: If the pattern or site cannot be determined, abstain rather than borrow an incompatible reference.
counterexamples: Using a solid-tumor boundary template for a lepidic focus.
Meeting the area budget by one narrow channel into lung parenchyma.
expected_morphology: Shallow distributed displacement at a pattern-matched, H&E-supported interface.
forbidden_morphology: Deep slot, pattern switch, remote component, or cross-site reference transfer.
known_limitations: Quantitative thresholds must be stratified by scale, specimen, and site.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.
